20フィート オープントップ · 20OT
Cargo taller than the walls is 'out / gauge' and costs more. Fewer / these boxes are available, so book early.

Cargo taller than the walls is 'out / gauge' (over-height). The tarpaulin cannot close, nothing can be stacked on top / it on the ship, and the line charges extra for the space it blocks. It needs the shipping line's approval before booking.
Send us the exact length, width, height and weight / each piece, ideally with a drawing, and we will tell you if it fits in gauge.

The long version / the open top, for long items that must be loaded from above.
規則 / thumb: about 3 tonnes per running metre. Lashing rings along the sides.
20フィート フラットラック · 20FR
A strong floor with two end walls and no sides or roof. Cargo can stick out / the sides or top.
Cargo wider or taller than the rack is 'out / gauge' and needs special stowage and pricing. Must be lashed properly.

Cargo stays within the outline / a normal container: no wider than the rack (2.44 m outside) and no taller than a standard container (2.59 m including the rack floor). It is handled almost like a normal box.

Cargo that is wider (over-width), taller (over-height) or longer (over-length) than that outline is 'out / gauge'. It takes up space next to or above it on the ship, so the line charges for those lost slots, and it may need special road permits or escorts in India.
For out-of-gauge cargo we need exact dimensions, weight, centre / gravity and lifting points before the line will accept the booking. Ask us early.
